data.title: Module Overview
data.body:
Welcome to Module 1

This module introduces the fundamental concepts you'll need throughout the course. By the end of this module, you will be able to:

  • Identify key terminology and concepts
  • Apply basic principles to real-world scenarios
  • Evaluate different approaches to problem-solving

Estimated Time: 3-4 hours

data.title: Learning Objectives
data.body:
By the end of this module, you will:

  1. Understand the historical context and development of the field
  2. Identify key concepts and their interrelationships
  3. Apply theoretical frameworks to practical examples
  4. Analyze case studies using appropriate methodologies
  5. Evaluate different perspectives and approaches

data.title: Required Readings
data.body:
Required Materials

  • Chapter 1: Introduction (textbook pages 1-25)
  • Smith, J. (2023). 'Foundational Concepts.' Journal of the Field, 45(2), 123-145.
  • Online resource: Interactive Tutorial

Supplemental Materials

  • Video lecture: Introduction to Key Concepts (20 minutes)
  • Podcast episode: Expert Interview (30 minutes)
